arguments.title: Correction: April 18, 2023 outage attribution
arguments.body: The April 18 outage was not caused by shard-keeper alone. Shard-keeper changed a label name in its configuration; downstream rollup-service was not updated to consume the new label. That producer–consumer mismatch impaired ingestion and made symptom alerts fire, while the cause alerts failed to fire. The incident lasted several hours; no data loss was reported.
